name: What elements should I prioritize in a bathroom remodel for resale value?

mainEntity.name: What elements should I prioritize in a bathroom remodel for resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maximize resale value, prioritize functional and aesthetic improvements. Focus on updating fixtures such as faucets, showerheads, and lighting to modern styles. Replace outdated vanities and countertops with cleaner, contemporary options. Ensure good ventilation and fresh paint. If budget allows, consider upgrading the shower/tub area, possibly to a walk-in shower. A clean, functional, and visually appealing bathroom universally attracts buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize updating fixtures, vanities, countertops, and lighting. Focus on creating a clean, functional, and visually appealing space to boost resale value.
